notes.title: Animallica - Final Beta!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody! After almost 5 years of development, Animallica reached its Final Beta phase and will be fully released soon!

We are very grateful for all your support so far and please continue to provide your feedback or report any bugs encountered, it will help us have a smooth release.

Even after the full release, Animallica will continue to receive free updates with both content and bug fixes.

Patch Notes:

 A new location was added: Mors Estate. A special key is required to enter the dungeon underneath Mors Estate and then the building itself.
 New animals were added: Beagle, Cane Corso, Snow Leopard and Domestic Shorthair Cat.
 Two new legendary animals named after the two contest winners (Marki and MovingTarget) were added.
 Numerous new crafting recipes were added.
 Nine new vivariums can now be crafted.
 A new settlement like building was added: Tavern.
 Over 50 unique framed pictures, drawings and paintings can now be found in the world while exploring.
 Almost 20 new plant clusters can be purchased from Corpse Harbor.
 New food items and crafting materials were added.
 An arrow showing the direction of placeables items where it wasn't obvious was added.
 Most maps were updated.
 Nights are now brighter.
 Some icons were updated.
 Some materials were updated.
 Some sounds were adjusted.
 Removed walking sound for tamed horses.
 Numerous bugs and visual glitches were fixed.

notes.content:
Hello Everybody, happy holidays!
Animallica Alpha v4.2 is here!
Patch Notes:
Because a part of the comunity requested a more guided experience, a task system was implemented with about 50 simple missions with a new curency as reward. The new curency can be used to aquire new powerful weapons and new rare animals. The new system could still require some tweeking but with your help hopefully it will work flawlessly soon. The new task system is intended for new players, to guide them through the story and all the areas. The other players can still experience it but some of the quests will be already completed.
This being said, Animallica remains a full sandbox game, meaning you can still tackle it in ay way you want, set your own pace and objectives.
Thirty new loading screens were added, explaining the background of most of the enemies and named NPCs in the game.
New weapons were added: Anti-Material Rifle and Tranquilizer Rifle.
The halloween pumpkins were removed and a Christmas tree was added in Arpashi.
The old Red Deer was retextured and is now a White-tailed deer.
A new Red Deer was added.
Red deer calf was added.
Nine new colors for Arabian Horse were added.
Two new colors for Grey Wolf were added.
Two new colors for Roe Deer were added.
Three new legendary animals were added: Alaskan Tundra Wolf, Steppe Wolf and Black rabicano Arabian Horse.
Some maps were updated with new points of interest.
Some items were renamed.
Some prices and recipes were adjusted.
Sleep interface was updated.
Several improvements for ranged enemies were made.
Fixed a problem with creature's dead animation;
Weapons like bows and crossbow now remeber the last type of arrow used.
You can now mine only by holding the mouse button.
Fixed a problem with Sarcophagus animations.

BUGFIXES:
Death with the inventory opened caused the player controller to be locked on respawn.
Fixed the Pick Up item command that allowed the players to pick the fired arrows right away with Alt+G.
When using Shift+Click on Gold Coin item from a Container, the gold coin amount wasn't visually updated properly.
Item quantity wasn't properly updated when transfering stackable items from the inventory to the quick bar.
The description of some items didn't fit the shop panel description area.
Corpses were not properly aligned with terrain.
Gardening Beds sometimes received an empty seed information, causing the bed to completely vanish.
Crafting with elements from char panel caused the tactical gloves to vanish.


Patch Notes v4.2a:
-> Added defense on armor tooltip / craft / shop menus
-> Added a missing pony to the Animal trader
-> Numerous small fixes
-> Improved the look of some textures

notes.title: Patch Notes: Animallica Alpha 4.05
Patch Notes: Animallica Alpha 4.0
notes.content:
Hello Everybody!
Animallica Alpha v 4.0 is here!
For start we have to specify that this is the first half of a two parts update. The second half will arrive in about a week and will include several new maps, a lot of new animals, ranged enemies and more lore. To experience the entire new feel of the game, a fresh game is highly recommended after these two patches, even though the old save files should still work properly.
We apologize for the long wait, but is was time to make several drastic changes to the game.

Patch Notes:
The combat system was completely remade; All weapons received new and better animations;
The inventory system was completely remade for better functionality and look;
A new safe map was added: Aleria;
Three new legendary animals were added;
Several cool new weapons were added: dual katanas, saw launcher, revolver, dual pistols, new shotgun;
An energy bar was added for melee weapons (used for power attack and fast combos);
A status bar was added on screen, permanently showing the amount of contamination left on the current map. Clearing all the enemy nests and contamination barrels from a map will clense the area from all signs of infection.
Some models were updated or replaced;
All maps were updated;
Added get hit animations for most of the creatures;
The maltese and caspain tigers are now named, legendary animals;
A Journal belonging to Dr. Mors can be now found somewhere in Nova;
Most of the enemy nests were replaced so you'll have to clean them again in an old save;
Added a command for pick all nearby droped items (default Alt + G).
Syringes that fully restore health or stamina were added;
New items were added;
Some recipes were updated;
The Landscapist is now selling several bonsai species;
The Mad Man received a facelift. He also is paying 25% more for your items now;
Armor rating was increased;
Spears and knives can now longer be used as weapons for now. You can always sell them;
Increased speed for the save/load system;
Multiple UI code improvements for performance were made;
Fixed a bug with companions duplicating;
Fixed a bug in Peaceful mode;
The swiming trigger for horse in Nova was fixed;
Fixed a bug with combat music;

Patch Notes for v4.0A:
-> Removed "Previous weapon" code & bind
-> Fixed F1 (Help) menu
-> Fixed Death Beacon drop on death
-> Multiple Char Panel bugfixes
->  Increased Saw Launcher damage
-> Fixed the issue with traps, they can be destroyed now
-> Improved melee hit detection system
-> Fixed the music fade in/out between standard and combat music (plus the underwater issues)
-> Fixed rare bug that caused inventory slot number to be negative, hence blocking the proper load of a category in the inventory
-> Fixed key binding bugs
-> Fixed animals that were sliding on flee
-> Decreased enemy damage
-> Inventory blurry view fixed

Patch Notes for v4.0b:
-> Fixed +10 Sniper Rifle and +25 Sniper Rifle Scope
-> Fixed swim hands
-> Fixed underwater sound
-> Fixed animals' description on animal trader from Corpse Harbor
-> Increased damage for some weapons
-> Removed battlecry sounds from farming tools
-> Minor changes to some scenes
-> Fixed inventory stack bugs (a bug that was also causing items to vanish)

Patch Notes for v4.0c:
-> Fixed quick bar bug that caused the items to be missing when selecting the slot
-> Gardening Bed UI can now be closed with the Escape key as well

Patch Notes for v4.0d:

-> Combat music: detect only enemies that are 30 meters away or less
-> Melee: play prepare attack (taunt) only once per attack.
-> Fixed holding jump button while swimming to reach the surface

-> Fixed bug that caused item of the same type to vanish when trying to stack it into a container

Patch Notes for v4.0e:
-> Fixed broken visuals for the containers with animations
-> Fixed bug when the code didn't properly load the start/finish time for settlements
-> Fixed save loading code for very old save files (December 2017, early 2018)
-> Fixed the "Drop Item" key command
-> Fixed stack higher than 1 for non-stackable items for inventory, quick bar, containers, bags
-> Fixed bugs when dying while riding
-> Fixed bugs caused by death under water

Patch Notes for v4.0f:
-> Fixed the bug that caused containers to be empty when opening them
-> Consume delay + slot overlay on quick bar
-> Fixed "Grass Remover"
-> Fixed missing Mad Man in Cultsberg
-> Fixed bug that caused Death Beacon to multiply itself on death

Patch Notes for v4.0g:
-> Fixed several bugs that occurred when performing actions like stack or transfer in inventory
-> Multiple craft panel visual bugfixes
-> Items that have enough materials to be crafted have green title now
-> Multiple Craft Panel code bugfixes
-> Recycle Bin bugfix (it wasn't properly closed sometimes)
-> Quick Panel stack bugfix
-> Updated Nova, Land Base and Kitsune's Den
-> Fixed a couple of bugfixes related to save files from 2018

Patch Notes for v4.0h:

-> Fixed a bug that wrongly stacked the items when crafting a large amount of materials at the same time
-> Fixed companions bug

-> Visual inventory bugfix when switching from craft panel to inventory panel (showing only a couple of inventory slot lines)

Patch Notes for v4.0j:
-> BUGFiX: Putting the stack split result into a sell panel caused the initial stack of the item to vanish
-> BUGFiX: Closing the sell panel with the TAB key without clicking the sell button didn't return the items from the sell panel as it should

Patch Notes for v4.0l:

-> Craft text button will change to fill / process / enchant, depending on the situation

-> New teleport screen menu
-> New loading screens
-> Bugfix AI animals

-> F1 and F3 keys for help and codex were removed, you can now access those two features when opening the inventory (two buttons on the middle right side of the screen)

IMPORTANT: Many thanks to lucyrocketdog for all the bug reporting and time investing in identifying and detailing every bug encountered

notes.content:
Animallica Alpha v 3.0 is live!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389889/d43153686e073dda3945e1908bd5f04f37e92bb6.png
Patch Notes:
We performed another Unity engine update that brings several optimizations and better performance;
The AI was completly rewritten for better performance and functionality;
The game files structure and compression was replaced to occupy less space and also lower the memory consumption;
Some models were better optimised;
Most of the low resolution textures were improved;
Kitsune Den's Map was revamped;
Greenhills, Nova, Akhali Desert and Corpse Harbor maps were slightly updated;
Shop interface was updated;

HOTFiX
 Reverted file structure of the game to insure lower download size by future updates
 Fixed the broken scale that was experienced by some of the animals
 Fixed skin for several tamed animals

HOTFiX v3.01
Fixed missing colliders for some objects
Fixed a bug with animals escaping their enclosures
Fixed a bug with health bar
Fixed a bug with swimming in Nova
Fixed Metal Gate
Riding Horses should now reset to their original position if they get stuck in water or in jumping animation
Readjusted the spawners
Optimized several placeable models

HOTFiX v3.01b
 Fixed Game Tooltip for tranqed animals
 Fixed bug that caused animals to slide backwards
 Fixed bug that caused animals to slide during attack
 Fixed broken collisions after the animals' death
 Fixed bug that caused companions to freeze
 Fixed Arrow tooltip for CrossBow
 Fixed combat music
 Fixed broken enemies behavior after players' death
 Re-added auto-run (default Shift+Q)
 You can change autorun bind on the controls menu
 Fixed Item Ghost for Vegetables Crate, Fruits Crate, Proteins Crate and Pastry Crate
 Optimized several items for better performance


We also want to announce that the next big updates will include in no particular order:
- Combat revamp
- Breeding barn
- Large customisable mansion with a display gallery and tones of new lore rich items to collect and display
- Genetic modifications for animals
- An unusual island with an even more unusual tower that will allow you to go back in time
- Mors Estate maps
- Creative mode

Also, new locations and animals will arrive with almost every new patch.

Please remember to try an integrity check on Steam before reporting a problem or bug. Most of the time it will solve your problem.

Thank you for your support and patience!

notes.title: Patch 1.16 notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Animallica v1.16 is live:

 Game crash during launch has been fixed
 Added Vertical Sync slider in the Settings menu
 Fixed Kitsune's Den broken chest
 Unlocked framerate while vertical sync is on (for monitors > 60 Hz)
 Added White Point setting in the In-Game Menu (similar with Gamma)
 Clicking on any button on the Pause Menu while riding made the horse move - fixed
 Game window is now recognized as full screen by recording apps that failed to do so
 Mouse cursor going out of the screen after several Alt+Tab - fixed
 Fixed arrows position after animal death
 Resolution drop-down menu has been fixed

NOTE: Regarding Vertical Sync, according to Unity's documentation

The number of VSyncs that should pass between each frame. Use 'Don't Sync' (0) to not wait for VSync. Value must be 0, 1 or 2.

By default, Animallica has vertical sync 0 (off).

Thank you for your support and patience!

New unique animal: Maltese Tiger
New animal: Cheetah

The crosshair is now turning red if you have a valid target

We fixed several bugs, the other known bugs are work in progress. We are also working on adding new and improved content, but the priority is fixing the bugs.

Sharp stone, rope, hardwood and tools are now more abundant on the starting island.

You can now ascend while underwater by holding space.

Fixed the bug with getting damage every 5 seconds after the character died underwater.

Covered the hole in the dock, near the ship at the teleport point in the main area.

Thank you for your support and patience!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 notes
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29389889/6e7cfa25b2946121446b9b9e1b1fa3224e542433.jpg

Hello everyone,

We want to thank you all for your help and patience in identifying bugs and other problems. We will continue to fix any problem you encounter and offer you a better experience in Animallica with every update.

Patch 1.01 is live:

A new animal was added into the game: Moose.
Field of view slider was added.
Horse controls are now displayed while riding.
Help screen content updated (press F1 in game).
Call horse command was temporary removed due to a bug.
Fixed cursor on multi-monitors.
Fixed bow/weapon switch animations.
Fixed getting damage from distance.
Fixed a bug where you could get stuck at teleport.
Removed tooltip text that was still visible on the teleport screen.
Fixed a bug with the crates respawning after being destroyed.
Fixed a problem when ESC was pressed when riding a horse. The menu appeared but the mouse cursor was stuck.
The monster nest near workshop in Cultsberg is now visible.
Head bobbing is now less obvious.
Reduced camera sensitivity while riding.
